boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time on campus or in Terre Haute; note student-only access where applicable.

cards.title: Cheer at a Rose-Hulman athletic event
cards.subtitle: Rose-Hulman campus
cards.notes: Check the athletics schedule, meet friends at the venue, and bring your Rose-Hulman ID for free admission to campus athletic events.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID-supported way to watch campus competition together.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose-Hulman Student Affairs states that a Rose-Hulman student ID provides free admission to Rose-Hulman athletic events.
cards.access_notes: Student ID required; event schedules and venue access vary.

cards.title: Walk the Career Fair together
cards.subtitle: Sports and Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the fair as a low-pressure group outing: compare employer displays, practice introductions, and collect ideas for later applications.
cards.short_summary: Career Services lists student events, including career fairs, as free.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose-Hulman Career Services says all of its events are free and open to any student on campus; its page lists the Spring and Fall Career Fairs.
cards.source_title: Career Services & Employer Relations – Info for Parents | Rose-Hulman
cards.access_notes: For Rose-Hulman students; confirm the current fair date and location before going.

cards.entity_name: Graduate School and Summer Research Fair
cards.title: Browse graduate-school and research options
cards.subtitle: Rose-Hulman Union
cards.notes: Go with a classmate, ask presenters one prepared question, and save programs or research leads that fit your interests.
cards.short_summary: A free Career Services event focused on graduate school and summer research.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose-Hulman Career Services lists the Graduate School and Summer Research Fair and says all of its events are free and open to any student on campus.
cards.source_title: Career Services & Employer Relations – Info for Parents | Rose-Hulman
cards.access_notes: For Rose-Hulman students; verify the scheduled date and Union room before attending.

cards.title: Set up a library study hang
cards.subtitle: John A. Logan Library, Rose-Hulman campus
cards.notes: Claim a welcoming study spot, bring a shared problem set or book, and use the library as a calm place to work alongside friends.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with welcoming study spaces and free student educational printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Logan Library describes welcoming study spaces and says RHIT students may use its printers, scanners, and photocopier for free for RHIT educational purposes.
cards.access_notes: Campus library access is intended for Rose-Hulman students, faculty, and staff; check current building hours.

cards.title: Look through American art downtown
cards.subtitle: Swope Art Museum, 25 S 7th St.
cards.notes: Meet at the galleries, choose one work each to discuss, then compare what caught everyone’s attention before heading out.
cards.short_summary: The museum states that admission is always free.
cards.evidence_claim: Swope Art Museum states that admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current public hours before visiting.

cards.title: See Larry Bird’s Terre Haute story
cards.subtitle: Larry Bird Museum, 800 Wabash Ave.
cards.notes: Browse the displays at your own pace, then pick one item or moment to share with the group on the way out.
cards.short_summary: A downtown sports-history museum with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Larry Bird Museum’s visitor information states that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current opening days and hours on the museum’s visitor page.

cards.title: Meet up at the public library
cards.subtitle: Vigo County Public Library, Main Library
cards.notes: Use the seating and public collections for a reading break, a board-game-style study session, or a quiet catch-up between classes.
cards.short_summary: A public library offering free access to its building and materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Vigo County Public Library describes itself as a free public library and provides public access to its Main Library.
cards.access_notes: Library cards may be needed to borrow materials; check current Main Library hours.

cards.title: Take a nature-center walk at Dobbs Park
cards.subtitle: Dobbs Park Nature Center, 5170 E Poplar St.
cards.notes: Use the nature center as a starting point, then take a relaxed walk on open trails and pause to read the interpretive displays.
cards.short_summary: A city nature center and park destination with free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: Terre Haute’s Parks Department lists Dobbs Park Nature Center as a city park facility and identifies its trails and nature-center amenities.
cards.source_title: Dobbs Park Nature Center | City of Terre Haute
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent; observe posted trail and nature-center rules.

cards.title: Walk the paths at Deming Park
cards.subtitle: Deming Park, 500 S Fruitridge Ave.
cards.notes: Pick a meeting point, take a daylight lap on the park paths, and bring a friend for an unstructured outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A Terre Haute municipal park for a no-purchase outdoor walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Terre Haute Parks lists Deming Park as a city park facility with outdoor recreation areas and paths.
cards.source_title: Deming Park | City of Terre Haute
cards.access_notes: Use during posted park hours and choose daylight for walking.

cards.title: Sit by the Wabash at Fairbanks Park
cards.subtitle: Fairbanks Park, 101 N 1st St.
cards.notes: Bring a snack from home if you like, use the open riverfront space for conversation, and leave time for a short walk nearby.
cards.short_summary: A city riverfront park for an outdoor conversation or walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Terre Haute Parks lists Fairbanks Park as a city park facility on the Wabash Riverfront.
cards.source_title: Fairbanks Park | City of Terre Haute
cards.access_notes: Use public park areas during posted hours; conditions can vary with weather and river levels.
